integrity: A standalone stdlib verifier performs exhaustive finite checks within specified bounds. The proof gives the infinite-family identity. All precursor correspondences and total enumerations are explicitly credited. No independent certification is claimed.
limitations: The result concerns closure operators on C_2 x C_n, n>=1, and an equivalent fixed-point statistic of saturated transfer systems on corresponding cyclic subgroup grids. It does not extend to general chain products or arbitrary transfer systems. Earlier work already determines the unrefined counts; no claim is made to a new total. Independent originality and mathematical audits remain outstanding.
title: Fixed-point-rank census for closures on two-row chain lattices
